subject: Redwood x LatticeOps — Mini Summit & Demo Sprint
messages:
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@latticeops.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Park <ben.park@latticeops.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Redwood x LatticeOps mini-summit (demo sprint)

Hi Jonas —

Quick note to see if Redwood would be interested in a short, co-branded remote mini-summit we are piloting for partners — thinking 90–120 minutes, 3 short partner demos (15 min each), one joint keynote on integration patterns, and an open Q&A. The goal is lead generation + product signal for integrations (not a deep workshop).

Proposed timing: week of Oct 18 (we can be flexible).

What we can offer from LatticeOps:
- Co-branded marketing (email + social) to our customer base (~4k)
- Registration page and live event hosting (we use EventsPro)
- One sponsor slot for Redwood to do a 20 min segment + 10 min live demo

Ask from Redwood:
- Confirm interest and target date window
- Speaker(s) for the 20 min demo + 2-sentence blurb and headshot
- Marketing contact and logo assets (SVG/PNG) by Oct 1 if we move forward

Attached: draft agenda (Redwood-LatticeOps-mini-summit-agenda.pdf) — very rough.

If this sounds useful we can run a 30 min sync next week to lock scope.

Thanks —
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, LatticeOps
sofia.alvarez@latticeops.com

Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Redwood x LatticeOps mini-summit (demo sprint)

Sofia —

Thanks for the thoughtful outline. Redwood is very interested — the format (short partner demos + a joint integration keynote) aligns with what we want to test for this quarter. Oct 18 works for us; we could also do Oct 20 if that helps scheduling.

Quick answers:
- I'll take the 20 min demo slot and do the live walkthrough with Karthik (field eng) on the integration surface and common infra patterns.
- Marketing contact: looping in Marissa to own creative and co-marketing cadence.
- We can get logos and a 2-sentence blurb by Oct 1.

Can we schedule a 30 min planning call Wed 9/15 at 11am PT to finalize run-of-show and sponsorship terms?

Jonas Weber
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
